items.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember Billy Cobham played on that too

ctx.x: I remember because I remember Billy Cobham played on that too and he was playing like the wind. He was playing like the wind on that one!
Yes, that’s right! Yeah, they did things on Inner Voices but he did it at Carnegie years ago with him and Bill [inaudible]. But I love big bands.
